description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level Software Developer with a strong interest in data management and database systems. This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals who want to build hands-on experience in application development, data processing, and database design.
 
This role is 100% onsite in Baltimore MD (Monday-Thursday 10 hour work days) 
Salary: $60,000-70,000/year

Responsibilities: 

 Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications.

 Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

 Develop and optimize database queries, reports, and stored procedures.

 Support data integration, migration, and validation efforts.

 Maintain and troubleshoot existing applications and databases.

 Help ensure data accuracy, integrity, and security.


Requirements: 

 Bachelors Degree in Computer Science

 Foundational knowledge of data/databases through coursework and/or internship experience
